description: TRA-40 failure-bundle production suite: the five distinct runnable failing cases for the refund/support family, each tripping a different verifier check, plus the four positive siblings from the canonical refund_v0 suite that prove the corresponding controls do not overblock. One batch run of this suite produces all five complete failure bundles through the shared pipeline and a batch summary that serves as the machine-readable manifest of their run IDs. Task files are shared with refund_v0 (Emily Au's canonical suite is the source); this manifest only sequences them for bundle production and does not duplicate any task.
